deskDonateLead: Donations fund development of this wallet.

@deskDonateLead.description: Settings › Donate: the line at the top of the page.

@deskDonatePage.description: Settings › Donate: the row that opens BT Labs' donation page in the browser; the host is under it.

@deskDonateOpen.description: Settings › Donate: the button that opens the page in the browser.

deskDonateNoAnswer: The donation page does not answer.

@deskDonateNoAnswer.description: Settings › Donate: notice when the donation page could not be reached or is not set.

deskDonateNoAnswerText: Send EPIC to the address below, or use the contact page.

@deskDonateNoAnswerText.description: Settings › Donate: text of the notice when the donation page does not answer.

deskDonateOffInMode: {mode}: the donation page is not opened.

@deskDonateOffInMode.description: Settings › Donate: notice title in Node only or Kill switch; {mode} is the network mode's name.

@deskDonateContact.description: Settings › Donate: opens BT Labs' contact page in the browser.

@deskDonateAddress.description: Settings › Donate: the row with the donation address, Copy and QR.

@deskDonateAddressQr.description: What the QR code is of, lower case after 'the' (as in 'Show the QR code of the donation address').

@deskDonateCopy.description: Settings › Donate: name of the copy button of the donation address.
